title: Sequenced Onboarding Gating and Remediation SOP for Air-gapped / VPC Customers
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a reproducible, operational SOP and intake flow that sequences customer onboarding gates for Private/VPC and air-gapped deployments. The SOP should combine automated pre-flight checks, a risk-scoring engine, and a prioritized remediation playbook so Solutions Engineers and Customer Success can quickly triage network/upgrade blockers and produce consistent timelines and communications for enterprise customers.
acceptance_criteria: A public-facing intake template in the Console for Private/VPC requests that captures required network artifacts and optional diagnostic bundles
Automated preflight runner (cloud agent + simple offline checklist) that returns a risk score and a categorized error list
A gating policy that maps risk score bands to three remediation paths: fast-track, assisted remediation, and engineering intake
Runbook pages (Confluence) for the top 10 common networking and airgap issues with step-by-step fixes and estimated MTTR
A deploy sequencing guideline that specifies upgrade windows, canary policies, and rollback triggers for air-gapped customers
Stakeholder signoff checklist and SLAs for each remediation path documented and approved by Security and Support
steps: 1) Finalize intake form fields with Solutions Eng and Security (network diagrams, firewall rules, jumpbox access, allowed egress endpoints, KMS/HSM notes)
2) Build lightweight preflight runner prototype (ENG-2874) that validates DNS routing, outbound allowlists, and basic MTU/path MTU issues
3) Design risk scoring rubric (0-100) and map score ranges to gating decisions
4) Draft remediation playbooks for: allowlist failures, large MTU mismatches, package upgrade blockers, time-sync issues, and certificate chain problems
5) Wire the preflight output into Console ticketing UX and Solutions Eng triage queue
6) Pilot with two existing enterprise customers (one VPC, one fully air-gapped) and iterate on checklist and runbooks
7) Finalize documentation, schedule training for Solutions Eng and Customer Success, and publish runbooks to Confluence
8) Post-pilot retro and update metrics and SLAs in the Console dashboard
notes: Trade-off: full automation will be expensive and brittle for strictly air-gapped customers; plan is hybrid: automated checks where possible, clear manual checklist for offline remediation
We must avoid exposing sensitive customer topology in Console logs; preflight artifacts should be optional and encrypted in transit (KMS) - coordinate with Security
Estimate assumes ENG-2874 and ENG-3012 deliver basic preflight infra; if blocked, fallback to manual checklist template
Use pilot customers to validate MTTR estimates; do not publish SLAs externally until pilot completes
